Spec 1 — Warn on a transcript that parses to nothing (highest value)

Goal: Don't silently produce a contentless checkpoint. extractTranscriptMetadata (attach_transcript.go:20-56) can return an all-zero meta (no user turns, no first prompt, no model). Attach then proceeds: attachPrompts returns nil (:194-199), attachStepCount floors the count to 1 (:187-189), and the checkpoint is written and reported as success (:380-393) with no prompt/title.

Change: After meta := extractTranscriptMetadata(transcriptData) (attach.go:288), if meta.FirstPrompt == "" && meta.TurnCount == 0, emit a warning to stderr (cmd.ErrOrStderr(), threaded in — not stdout) like: warning: no user prompts were parsed from this transcript; the checkpoint will have no recorded prompt. Verify the --agent value (got %q) and session ID. Then continue (still write the checkpoint).

Critical constraint — must be a warning, not a hard error. extractTranscriptMetadata only understands generic JSONL + Gemini JSON. Agents whose user-content shape isn't matched by transcript.ExtractUserContent (codex/copilot/pi/factory formats) can legitimately yield an empty meta while the transcript is valid and agent.CalculateTokenUsage (:342, agent-specific) still works. A hard failure would regress attach for those agents. Warn only.

--review note: when opts.Review and the prompt is empty, reviewPromptForAttach (:604-609) records an empty review prompt — call that out specifically in the warning when opts.Review is set, since the review prompt is the point of --review.

Plumbing: runAttach currently takes only w io.Writer (stdout). Add an errW io.Writer param (or pass cmd.ErrOrStderr() through runAttachSurfaceReviewErrors/runAttach) so the warning lands on stderr, not interleaved with the success lines on stdout.

Tests: add to attach_test.go — a transcript that extracts to empty produces the warning on stderr and still writes the checkpoint (assert both). Use testutil.InitRepo per the git-isolation rule.

Effort: S · Impact: High.

---
Spec 2 — Post-attach summary footer

Goal: Confirm what was captured. Today success prints only Attached session X + Created/Added … checkpoint Y (:380-386); entire session info shows richer stats but attach gives none.

Change: In runAttach, after the Attached session %s line (:380) on the real-attach path, print a one-line summary from data already in scope: meta.TurnCount (turns), meta.Model (model), and tokenUsage (*agent.TokenUsage, :342). Example:   Captured: 12 turns · claude-opus-4-8 · 1.3k tokens. Guard each field: skip turns if 0, skip model if empty, skip tokens if tokenUsage == nil.

Scope note: only the actual-attach path (reaches :380) has meta. The "session already has checkpoint" early return (:237-256) runs before meta is computed — leave it as-is (no footer there).

Tests: extend the existing happy-path attach test to assert the footer renders with turns/model; add a case with tokenUsage == nil to confirm the token segment is omitted.

Effort: S · Impact: Med.

---
Spec 3 — Surface the amend-failure reason to the user

Goal: When --amend fails, tell the user why on screen. Currently promptAmendCommit returns the wrapped git error (:771), but the caller logs it via logging.Warn (:389, :252) — which writes to .entire/logs/, not the terminal (attach calls logging.Init at :203). The user sees the fallback trailer (:390) but no indication the amend was attempted and failed.

Change: At the two call sites (:388-391 and :251-254), in addition to the existing logging.Warn, print a brief stderr note before the fallback trailer: Could not amend the commit automatically (%v). Keep the full error in the log; keep the existing "Copy to your commit message…" fallback. Use the errW writer added in Spec 1.

Caveat — honest payoff: the recovery path already works (the trailer is printed and attach returns nil). This only improves diagnosability; it's polish, not a correctness fix. Bundle it with Spec 1 since both need the stderr writer.

Tests: there's currently no test for the amend-decline / amend-fail branches (:757-764, :769-772). Add one for the decline path (assert the fallback trailer prints) and, if feasible with a stubbed git, the fail path.

Effort: S (with Spec 1's plumbing) · Impact: Low.

---
Spec 4 — Help-text accuracy (doc-only)

Goal: Two true behaviors aren't documented.

Changes:
1. --force flag help (:145) — append that the amend is best-effort: …amend the last commit (best-effort; if the amend fails the checkpoint is still created and the trailer is printed for manual paste). (matches :388-391).
2. Long help (:84-99) — add a sentence: If --agent doesn't locate a transcript, Entire auto-detects the agent from the transcript and prints the detected agent name. (matches :645-654).

Tests: none (cosmetic). Optionally a golden-help assertion if one exists.

Effort: XS · Impact: Low–Med (reduces "transcript not found" dead-ends).

---
Recommended order: Spec 1 (real value) bundled with Spec 3 (shared stderr plumbing), then Spec 2, then Spec 4. Specs 1+2+4 are the ones worth doing on their own merits.
I'll start by reading the relevant files to ground myself in the actual code before implementing.

42		Force bool
43		// Review, when true, tags the attached session as a review. Skills are
44		// resolved inside runAttach after the real agent is known (via session
45		// state or transcript auto-detection), not at the cobra layer — the

47		// make a Gemini session incorrectly look up review.claude-code config.

201	func runAttach(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer, sessionID string, agentName types.AgentName, opts attachOptions) error {
202		// Initialize structured logger so logging.Warn/Info write to .entire/logs/ not stderr.
203		if err := logging.Init(ctx, sessionID); err != nil {
204			// Init failed — logging will use stderr fallback, non-fatal.
205			_ = err
206		}
207		// Flush the 8KB buffered log writer on exit. Without this, any
208		// Warn/Info calls during attach (including the overwrite tripwire)
209		// get silently dropped when the process exits, matching the pattern
210		// already used by resume/clean/reset/rewind/explain.
211		defer logging.Close()
212	
213		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "attach")
214	
215		// Open repository once — shared across all operations.

218			return err

300			repo = refreshedRepo

376		if err := saveAttachSessionState(logCtx, repo, existingState, sessionID, ag.Type(), transcriptPath, checkpointID, meta, tokenUsage, opts, reviewSkills); err != nil {
377			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to save session state", "error", err)
378		}

386		fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Created checkpoint %s\n", checkpointID)
387		cpIDStr := checkpointID.String()
388		if err := promptAmendCommit(logCtx, w, headCommit, cpIDStr, opts.Force); err != nil {
389			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to amend commit", "error", err)
390			fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nCopy to your commit message to attach:\n\n  Entire-Checkpoint: %s\n", cpIDStr)

396	// checkpointHasSessionMetadata reports whether sessionID has existing metadata
397	// at Primary. Reads target Primary directly, not refs.Read, because this guard
398	// must reflect what the next write would target.
399	func checkpointHasSessionMetadata(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, refs cpkg.PersistentRefs, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, sessionID string) (bool, error) {
400		store, err := openAttachStore(ctx, repo, refs.PrimaryAsRead())
401		if err != nil {
402			return false, err
403		}
404		summary, err := store.Read(ctx, checkpointID)
405		if err != nil {
406			return false, fmt.Errorf("read checkpoint summary: %w", err)
407		}
408		if summary == nil {
409			return false, nil
410		}
411		for i := range summary.Sessions {
412			metadata, err := store.ReadSessionMetadata(ctx, checkpointID, i)
413			if err != nil {
414				return false, fmt.Errorf("read session %d metadata: %w", i, err)
415			}
416			if metadata != nil && metadata.SessionID == sessionID {
417				return true, nil
418			}
419		}
420		return false, nil
421	}

423	// getHeadCommit returns the HEAD commit object.
424	func getHeadCommit(repo *git.Repository) (*object.Commit, error) {
425		headRef, err := repo.Head()
426		if err != nil {
427			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
428		}
429		commit, err := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
430		if err != nil {
431			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD commit: %w", err)
432		}
433		return commit, nil
434	}

436	// ensureCheckpointAvailable makes sure the checkpoint referenced by HEAD is
437	// present locally before the attach writes to it. Without this guard, attach
438	// would create a fresh session 0 under the same ID and overwrite the original
439	// session data on push.
440	//
441	// Only the local branch counts — remote-tracking presence is not enough.
442	// If only the remote-tracking ref exists, a subsequent WriteCommitted creates
443	// a brand-new orphan local branch with an empty tree, which would clobber
444	// the remote on push.
445	//
446	// Fast path: check local refs directly — no network. If missing, trigger the
447	// metadata fetch fallback chain used by `entire resume` (which advances the
448	// local ref on success) and re-check. Returns a possibly-freshly-opened repo
449	// handle so go-git sees any newly fetched packfiles.
450	func ensureCheckpointAvailable(ctx, logCtx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, refs cpkg.PersistentRefs, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, isExistingCheckpoint bool) (*git.Repository, error) {
451		if !isExistingCheckpoint {
452			return repo, nil
453		}
454	
455		present, readErr := checkpointPresentLocally(ctx, repo, refs, checkpointID)

496	// Primary locally. Reads target Primary directly, not refs.Read, because this
497	// asks what the next write would find, not what readers see. A missing local
498	// ref is reported as absent; the caller is responsible for any remote refresh.
499	func checkpointPresentLocally(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, refs cpkg.PersistentRefs, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) (bool, error) {

501			return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Missing ref is the "absent" signal, not an error.

503		store, err := openAttachStore(ctx, repo, refs.PrimaryAsRead())

507		summary, err := store.Read(ctx, checkpointID)

509			return false, err //nolint:wrapcheck // Caller wraps with checkpoint ID context

541	// saveAttachSessionState creates or updates the session state file for the attached session.
542	// If existingState is non-nil, it is updated in place (avoids a redundant disk load).
543	// reviewSkills is the resolved skills list when opts.Review is true; ignored otherwise.
544	func saveAttachSessionState(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, existingState *session.State, sessionID string, agentType types.AgentType, transcriptPath string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, meta transcriptMetadata, tokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage, opts attachOptions, reviewSkills []string) error {
545		stateStore, err := session.NewStateStore(ctx)
546		if err != nil {
547			return fmt.Errorf("failed to open session store: %w", err)
548		}

550		now := time.Now()
551		state := existingState
552		if state == nil {
553			state = &session.State{
554				SessionID: sessionID,
555				StartedAt: now,
556			}
557		}
558	
559		// Populate BaseCommit from HEAD if not already set, so the session becomes
560		// active and future commits in the same session receive Entire-Checkpoint trailers.
561		if state.BaseCommit == "" {
562			if head, headErr := repo.Head(); headErr == nil {
563				headHash := head.Hash().String()
564				state.BaseCommit = headHash
565				state.AttributionBaseCommit = headHash
566			}
567		}
568	
569		state.CLIVersion = versioninfo.Version
570		state.AttachedManually = true
571		state.AgentType = agentType
572		state.TranscriptPath = transcriptPath
573		state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
574		// Only transition to Ended if the session is not already active — avoid
575		// breaking an ongoing session whose BaseCommit has just been restored above.
576		if !state.Phase.IsActive() {
577			state.Phase = session.PhaseEnded
578		}
579		state.LastInteractionTime = &now
580		if meta.TurnCount > 0 {
581			state.SessionTurnCount = meta.TurnCount
582		}
583		if meta.Model != "" {
584			state.ModelName = meta.Model
585		}
586		if meta.FirstPrompt != "" {
587			state.LastPrompt = meta.FirstPrompt
588		}
589		if tokenUsage != nil {
590			state.TokenUsage = tokenUsage
591		}
592		if opts.Review {
593			state.Kind = session.KindAgentReview
594			state.ReviewSkills = reviewSkills
595			state.ReviewPrompt = reviewPromptForAttach(meta, opts)
596		}
597	
598		if err := stateStore.Save(ctx, state); err != nil {
599			return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
600		}

602	}

612	// Returns the existing session state if the session is already tracked (nil if new).
613	func validateAttachPreconditions(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, sessionID string) (*session.State, error) {

634	// resolveAgentAndTranscript resolves the agent and transcript path.
635	// For existing sessions, resolves the agent from session state's AgentType.
636	// For new sessions, uses the --agent flag with auto-detection fallback.
637	func resolveAgentAndTranscript(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer, sessionID string, agentName types.AgentName, existingState *session.State) (agent.Agent, string, error) {
638		ag, err := resolveAgent(existingState, agentName)
639		if err != nil {
640			return nil, "", err
641		}
642	
643		transcriptPath, err := resolveAndValidateTranscript(ctx, sessionID, ag)
644		if err != nil {
645			// Auto-detect: try all other agents.
646			detectedAg, detectedPath, detectErr := detectAgentByTranscript(ctx, sessionID, agentName)
647			if detectErr != nil {
648				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("%w (also tried auto-detecting other agents: %w)", err, detectErr)
649			}
650			ag = detectedAg
651			transcriptPath = detectedPath
652			logging.Info(ctx, "auto-detected agent from transcript", "agent", ag.Name())
653			fmt.Fprintf(w, "Auto-detected agent: %s\n", ag.Name())
654		}

656		return ag, transcriptPath, nil

659	// resolveAgent resolves the agent to use. For existing sessions with an AgentType,
660	// uses agent.GetByAgentType. Otherwise falls back to the --agent flag.
661	func resolveAgent(existingState *session.State, agentName types.AgentName) (agent.Agent, error) {
662		if existingState != nil && existingState.AgentType != "" {
663			ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(existingState.AgentType)
664			if err == nil {
665				return ag, nil
666			}
667			// Fall through to flag-based resolution.
668		}
669		ag, err := agent.Get(agentName)
670		if err != nil {
671			return nil, fmt.Errorf("agent %q not available: %w", agentName, err)
672		}
673		return ag, nil
674	}

676	// resolveAndValidateTranscript finds the transcript file for a session, searching alternative
677	// project directories if needed.
678	func resolveAndValidateTranscript(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, ag agent.Agent) (string, error) {
679		transcriptPath, err := resolveTranscriptPath(ctx, sessionID, ag)
680		if err != nil {
681			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve transcript path: %w", err)
682		}
683		// Only call PrepareTranscript when the file already exists — it flushes
684		// in-progress writes, but can't conjure a file that was never started.
685		// This avoids agents like Cursor polling for 3s on non-existent files
686		// during auto-detection.
687		if _, statErr := os.Stat(transcriptPath); statErr == nil {
688			if preparer, ok := agent.AsTranscriptPreparer(ag); ok {
689				if prepErr := preparer.PrepareTranscript(ctx, transcriptPath); prepErr != nil {
690					logging.Debug(ctx, "PrepareTranscript failed (best-effort)", "error", prepErr)
691				}
692			}
693			return transcriptPath, nil
694		}
695		found, searchErr := searchTranscriptInProjectDirs(sessionID, ag)
696		if searchErr == nil {
697			logging.Info(ctx, "found transcript in alternative project directory", "path", found)
698			return found, nil
699		}
700		logging.Debug(ctx, "fallback transcript search failed", "error", searchErr)
701		return "", fmt.Errorf("transcript not found for agent %q with session %s; is the session ID correct?", ag.Name(), sessionID)
702	}
703	
704	// detectAgentByTranscript tries all registered agents (except skip) to find one whose
705	// transcript resolution succeeds for the given session ID.
706	func detectAgentByTranscript(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, skip types.AgentName) (agent.Agent, string, error) {
707		for _, name := range agent.List() {
708			if name == skip {
709				continue
710			}
711			ag, err := agent.Get(name)
712			if err != nil {
713				continue
714			}
715			path, resolveErr := resolveAndValidateTranscript(ctx, sessionID, ag)
716			if resolveErr != nil {
717				logging.Debug(ctx, "auto-detect: agent did not match", "agent", string(name), "error", resolveErr)
718				continue
719			}
720			return ag, path, nil
721		}
722		return nil, "", errors.New("transcript not found for any registered agent")
723	}

725	// promptAmendCommit shows the last commit and asks whether to amend it with the checkpoint trailer.
726	// When force is true, it amends without prompting.
727	func promptAmendCommit(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer, headCommit *object.Commit, checkpointIDStr string, force bool) error {
728		shortHash := headCommit.Hash.String()[:7]
729		subject := strings.SplitN(headCommit.Message, "\n", 2)[0]
730	
731		// Skip amending if this exact checkpoint ID is already in the commit.
732		for _, existing := range trailers.ParseAllCheckpoints(headCommit.Message) {
733			if existing.String() == checkpointIDStr {
734				fmt.Fprintf(w, "Commit %s already has Entire-Checkpoint: %s\n", shortHash, checkpointIDStr)
735				return nil
736			}
737		}
738	
739		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nLast commit: %s %s\n", shortHash, subject)
740	
741		amend := true
742		if !force {
743			if !interactive.CanPromptInteractively() {
744				// Non-interactive: can't prompt, print trailer for manual use.
745				fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nCopy to your commit message to attach:\n\n  Entire-Checkpoint: %s\n", checkpointIDStr)
746				return nil
747			}
748			form := NewAccessibleForm(
749				huh.NewGroup(
750					huh.NewConfirm().
751						Title("Amend the last commit in this branch?").
752						Affirmative("Y").
753						Negative("n").
754						Value(&amend),
755				),
756			)
757			if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
758				return fmt.Errorf("prompt failed: %w", err)
759			}
760		}
761	
762		if !amend {
763			fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nCopy to your commit message to attach:\n\n  Entire-Checkpoint: %s\n", checkpointIDStr)
764			return nil
765		}
766	
767		newMessage := trailers.AppendCheckpointTrailer(headCommit.Message, checkpointIDStr)
768	
769		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "commit", "--amend", "--only", "-m", newMessage)
770		if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
771			return fmt.Errorf("failed to amend commit: %w\n%s", err, output)
772		}
773	
774		fmt.Fprintf(w, "Amended commit %s with Entire-Checkpoint: %s\n", shortHash, checkpointIDStr)
775		return nil
776	}

445	// Regression for https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/1014#pullrequestreview-copilot:
446	// Bob clones a repo where Alice's checkpoint is on the remote-tracking ref
447	// (refs/remotes/origin/entire/checkpoints/v1) but the local branch doesn't
448	// exist yet. Read falls back to the remote-tracking tree, so a naive
449	// "read and check" guard would think all is well. But WriteCommitted would
450	// then create a *fresh* orphan local branch, and Bob's push would clobber
451	// Alice's data on origin. Attach must refuse in this shape.
452	func TestAttach_RefusesWhenCheckpointOnlyInRemoteTrackingRef(t *testing.T) {
453		setupAttachTestRepo(t)
454	
455		repoRoot := mustGetwd(t)
456		repo, err := git.PlainOpen(repoRoot)
457		if err != nil {
458			t.Fatal(err)
459		}
460	
461		// Seed the local branch with a checkpoint representing Alice's session.
462		alicesCheckpoint := id.MustCheckpointID("abcdef012345")
463		store := cpkg.NewGitStore(repo, cpkg.DefaultV1Refs())
464		if writeErr := store.Write(context.Background(), cpkg.Session{
465			CheckpointID: alicesCheckpoint,
466			SessionID:    "alice-original",
467			Strategy:     "manual-commit",
468			Transcript:   redact.AlreadyRedacted([]byte(`{"type":"user","message":"hi"}` + "\n")),
469			AuthorName:   "Alice",
470			AuthorEmail:  "alice@example.com",
471		}); writeErr != nil {
472			t.Fatalf("WriteCommitted: %v", writeErr)
473		}
474	
475		// Move the populated branch to the remote-tracking ref, then delete the
476		// local ref. This is the shape `git clone` produces for a branch the user
477		// never explicitly checked out locally.
478		localRef := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName)
479		remoteTrackingRef := plumbing.NewRemoteReferenceName("origin", paths.MetadataBranchName)
480		populated, err := repo.Reference(localRef, true)
481		if err != nil {
482			t.Fatalf("reading local ref: %v", err)
483		}
484		if setErr := repo.Storer.SetReference(plumbing.NewHashReference(remoteTrackingRef, populated.Hash())); setErr != nil {
485			t.Fatalf("SetReference remote-tracking: %v", setErr)
486		}
487		if rmErr := repo.Storer.RemoveReference(localRef); rmErr != nil {
488			t.Fatalf("RemoveReference local: %v", rmErr)
489		}
490	
491		// Amend HEAD so attach treats this as an existing-checkpoint case.
492		runGitInDir(t, repoRoot, "commit", "--amend", "-m", "init\n\nEntire-Checkpoint: "+alicesCheckpoint.String())
493	
494		sessionID := "bob-attempted-attach"
495		setupClaudeTranscript(t, sessionID, `{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":"hi"},"uuid":"u1"}
496	`)
497	
498		var out bytes.Buffer
499		err = runAttach(context.Background(), &out, sessionID, agent.AgentNameClaudeCode, attachOptions{Force: true})
500		if err == nil {
501			t.Fatal("expected attach to refuse when checkpoint is only in the remote-tracking ref")
502		}
503		if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "missing from the local entire/checkpoints/v1 branch") {
504			t.Errorf("error should explain the local-branch gap; got: %v", err)
505		}
506	
507		// Local branch must still not exist — attach should not have created a
508		// fresh orphan on refuse.
509		if _, refErr := repo.Reference(localRef, true); refErr == nil {
510			t.Error("local entire/checkpoints/v1 branch was created despite refuse; would clobber remote on push")
511		}
512	
513		// Remote-tracking ref must still hold Alice's untouched data.
514		remoteRef, err := repo.Reference(remoteTrackingRef, true)
515		if err != nil {
516			t.Fatalf("remote-tracking ref missing: %v", err)
517		}
518		if remoteRef.Hash() != populated.Hash() {
519			t.Errorf("remote-tracking ref moved from %s to %s", populated.Hash(), remoteRef.Hash())
520		}
521	}
